title: 钢锭从哪来
Where the ingots come from
body:
拆船时，船壳、甲板这些废料掉进船坞熔炉，炼成钢锭。

结算时把钢锭拖进“我的仓库”。F3 看有多少吨。

交易行里也能买钢锭（等级 1 黑色炉料）。
Scrap from the hull goes into the berth furnace and comes out as ingots. Keep them at settlement and they go to the cargo warehouse (row A1); F3 shows how many tonnes. The exchange sells ingots too.

title: 把钢锭送到炉口
Send the ingots to the furnace
body:
加工区要先修好一期。

在引导卡上按「送料到炉口」，或者到加工区炉台按 E，填好这一炉的吨数（0.25～2 吨），点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。

料自己送过去，大约 20 秒。在哪按都行。

The processing district must be mended first. Press Send the feed on the guide card, or at the furnace desk set 0.25–2 t and send it. The forklift and the rail trolley bring it in about 20 s; it travels while you fly over.

title: 通电熔化
Strike the arcs
body:
料到了，按「通电熔化」。温度它自己管。

熔得多快，看炉台上的功率百分比，旁边写着大约多久能出钢。

动力区没修时，全港只有一台旧主机，约 6 兆瓦，电弧炉功率只有 15% 左右，一炉 2 吨要十几分钟。

At the desk, Strike the arcs: it charges, strikes and holds the temperature by itself. How fast depends on the power it gets; the desk shows what it draws, what it is given and how long is left. With the power district unmended the port has about 6 MW, and the furnace gets 3–4 of its 24 MW: a 2 t heat takes over ten minutes.

title: 电力不足怎么办
Short of power
body:
三条路：

· 买块电池顶着；
· 在供电屏把加工区排到拆船区前面，拆船现场功率会降；
· 修动力区：一期能发 30 兆瓦，从此够用。

拆船时，船坞熔炉排在前面会把电拿走，电弧炉功率掉到 0% 就停下降温；拆完再回来，它接着熔。

Three ways, each with a price: buy power (five times dearer than our own), move processing ahead of salvage at the power control screen (salvage slows), or mend the power district (30 MW at stage 1). While you strip a ship the berth furnace comes first and the arc furnace may stop and cool; it carries on afterwards.

title: 测温取样，再出钢
Sample, then tap
body:
全部熔化、温度到 1640 °C 以后，炉台按「测量温度并采集样本」。等测温探头完全收回，再按「倾斜炉体，排出钢水」。

超过 1710 °C 会把成品烧成低等级。装了自动测温出钢以后，这两步由机器自己做。
Once all is melted at 1640 °C, Take a sample; when the probe is up, Tilt and tap. Over 1710 °C downgrades the product. With the auto unit fitted, the machine does both.

title: 钢坯冷却、运回仓库
Billets cool and go to the warehouse
body:
出完钢炉子空了，温度往下掉。

钢坯凉两三分钟，吊轨车运回仓库。完成时弹出“本次加工完成”，写着多少吨、放在哪一排。

连续轧开着的话，钢坯一入库就直接轧成钢板。

After tapping the furnace is empty and draws nothing; its temperature falls, as it should. The billets cool on the line for two or three minutes and the trolley takes them home. A card says how many tonnes and which row; F3 shows them under Products. With the mill rolling on, billet is rolled into plate as soon as it comes in.

title: 卖钢坯和钢板
Selling billet and plate
body:
按 F8 打开交易行，在「出售」里选货、填数量和价格挂牌；有人买就成交，钱当场到账，货由叉车和码头送走。

也可以在公司仓库（F3）点那样东西，按「去交易行挂牌卖」。

完整设备不用挂牌：在公司仓库或零件架上直接出售。

F8 opens the exchange: under Sell, pick the goods, quantity and price; when someone buys, the cash is there at once and the goods ship. From the stores (F3), a thing's List it button does the same. Whole equipment sells straight from the stores or the parts rack.

title: 拆下来的东西怎么算
What salvage becomes
body:
船壳、甲板、龙骨这些废料进熔炉，炼成钢锭；完整设备走设备口，结算时放进“我的仓库”就进了零件架，也可以当场卖掉；危险品走危险品口。

没分选的废金属要先在分选台分开、化验位定级，才能当炉料。

Hull, decks and keel become scrap and then ingots in the furnace; whole equipment goes in by the equipment mouth and, kept at settlement, onto the parts rack (or sold there and then); hazards use theirs. Unsorted scrap must be sorted and assayed before it is furnace feed.

heat.idle: 下一步：选好数量，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。还没买料的话，先去交易行买等级 1 黑色炉料，并等它入库。
NEXT: choose a quantity and bring stored feed to the furnace. Buy grade 1 feed and await warehouse receipt first.
heat.transport: 下一步：等搬运车把料送到炉口，再按「通电熔化」。
NEXT: wait for the feed at the furnace, then strike the arcs.
heat.processing: 按「通电熔化」。化完了测温，探头收回再出钢。
NEXT: strike the arcs — the roof closes, the electrodes come down, power runs itself. Melted and hot: sample, then tap once the probe is up.
heat.returning: 下一步：等钢坯冷却并运回仓库。到库后再去交易行交货。
NEXT: wait for cooling and warehouse return before selling.
heat.complete: 这一炉已回仓。去交易行的「工业客户」安排交货。
THIS HEAT IS BACK IN STOCK. Arrange delivery under Industrial Clients.
heat.success: STARTED. Wait for the robot to bring feed before charging.
sort.send_feed: 把仓库废料送到分选机
market.purchase_success: 买好了。先等货到仓库，再去下方炉台按 E，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。
PURCHASED. Wait for warehouse receipt, then use E at the furnace and bring the stored feed over.
